findings.evidence: The namespace at lines 96–147 exposes only `isInvertible`, `ofIsInvertible`, and `nonempty_iff_isInvertible`, while the parallel local-generator API already provides `LocalGeneratorsData.ofIso` at `Invertible/Basic.lean:85`.
findings.fix: Add `LocalTrivializations.ofIso (t : LocalTrivializations M) (e : M ≅ N) : LocalTrivializations N`, preserving `I`, `X`, and `coversTop` and composing `t.iso i` with `(SheafOfModules.overFunctor R (t.X i)).mapIso e`; provide simp lemmas for its projections.
findings.issue: `LocalTrivializations` has no `ofIso`/transport API, so an atlas cannot be reused when its sheaf is replaced by an isomorphic one without reconstructing the structure and composing restricted isomorphisms manually.

summary: The atlas type lacks the basic transport operation needed to use local trivializations through sheaf isomorphisms.
